purpose: We are developing new nicotine pouch flavours and want to know which age groups and regions have the most smokers' lung disease, to position the products as a 'healthier alternative'.
question: How many patients have COPD, by 10-year age band and region?
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Report per region and age band: patients with COPD.
